<script>
(function () {
  /* Section counts in the top links */
  document.querySelectorAll('.out-nav .n').forEach(function (el) {
    el.textContent = document.querySelectorAll('#' + el.dataset.count + ' .out-item').length;
  });
  /* Move the date out of "Outlet · Month D, YYYY · Place" into the left column */
  var MONTHS = ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];
  document.querySelectorAll('.out-item').forEach(function (item) {
    var meta = item.querySelector('.out-meta');
    if (!meta) return;
    var parts = meta.textContent.split(' · ');
    var idx = -1;
    parts.forEach(function (p, i) { if (idx === -1 && /\b(19|20)\d{2}$/.test(p.trim())) idx = i; });
    if (idx === -1) return;
    var raw = parts.splice(idx, 1)[0].trim();
    var m = raw.match(/^([A-Za-z]+)\s+\d{1,2},\s+(\d{4})$/);
    var date = document.createElement('div');
    date.className = 'out-date';
    date.textContent = m && MONTHS.indexOf(m[1]) > -1 ? m[1].slice(0, 3) + ' ' + m[2] : raw;
    item.insertBefore(date, item.firstChild);
    meta.textContent = parts.join(' · ');
  });
})();
</script>
